title: BortonWrightonLabs/dram pipeline parameters
description: DRAM (Distilled and Refined Annotation of Metabolism) is a tool for annotating metagenomic assembled genomes

pipeline_steps.title: Pipeline Steps
pipeline_steps.description: Which steps to run in the pipeline.

rename.description: Rename FASTA headers based on file name. Example: sample1.fa --> (fasta header renamed to) > sample1......  Why? DRAM output is focused on scaffolds/contigs with respect to each provided input input_fasta. Thus, without renaming FASTA headers, the individual scaffolds/contigs will not be distinguashable. *If you have already renamed your FASTA headers, do not include with '--call'.

call.description: Whether to call genes on the input FASTA files using Prodigal.

annotate.description: Annotate called genes using downloaded databases.

qc.description: Run quality control steps. With --input_fasta, DRAM scans for rRNA and tRNA; without FASTA, optional precomputed --rrnas and --trnas tables can be collected. QC can enrich generated or supplied annotations with bin quality and taxonomy.

summarize.description: Summarize annotations into a distilled output file. Will use all available topic distillate forms. Ecosystem

visualize.description: Generate a product visualization of the annotations and save the output to the output directory.

traits.description: Using a DRAM annotations file, make a table of adjectives. Still in development, but can still be used.

merge_annotations.description: Path to directory pointing to multiple DRAM annotations to merge into one file. This is ran as a separate pipeline.

format_kegg.description: Format KEGG database for use in DRAM. Standalone operation, will exit after completion.

format_mmseqs_gpu.description: Format an existing protein MMseqs database for GPU searches. Standalone operation.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

input_fasta.help_text: This parameter is *mandatory*. Files may be uncompressed (.fa/.fna/.fasta) or gzip-compressed (.fa.gz/.fna.gz/.fasta.gz); compressed inputs are decompressed automatically before downstream stages.

fasta_fmt.description: Input glob for the FASTA files. The default matches both plain and .gz files.

input_genes.description: Directory containing called genes. Only used when not running call. This allows you to provide pre-called genes to the pipeline. This is a PRODIGAL output trans_file format.

genes_fmt.description: Input format for the Genes file.

genes_fna_fmt.description: Input format for the Genes fna file. Used for certain database searches such as RGI when not running with raw fasta files. This is a PRODIGAL output nuc_file format

call_prodigal_options.title: Call Prodigal Options
call_prodigal_options.description: Call genes on the input FASTA files using Prodigal.

min_contig_len.description: Minimum contig length in base pairs.

anno_dbs.description: Alternative way to specify database list for annotation. Comma sepeterated list of databases to include in the annotates. Use `all` for all. Example: 'kegg,dbcan,kofam,merops,viral,camper,canthyd,fegenie,sulfur,methyl,uniref,pfam,vogdb'. When in doubt, use the name after `use_` for each database. This option overrides individual `use_` database flags. (WARNING, this option name may change in the future)

use_dram_db.description: Use the DRAM team specialized databases for annotation.

use_camper.description: Use the CAMPer database for annotation.

use_canthyd.description: Use the Cant_Hyd database for annotation.

use_dbcan.description: Use the dbCAN database for annotation.

use_fegenie.description: Use the FeGenie database for annotation.

use_kegg.description: Use the KEGG database for annotation.

use_kofam.description: Use the Kofam database for annotation.

use_merops.description: Use the MEROPS database for annotation.

use_methyl.description: Use the Methyl database for annotation.

use_pfam.description: Use the PFAM database for annotation. Currently disabled for this release as a bug was discovered with the pfam DRAM2 implementation. It will be re-enabled in the next release.

use_sulfur.description: Use the Sulfur database for annotation.

use_uniref.description: Use the UniRef database for annotation.

use_metals.description: Use the Metals database for annotation.

use_antismash.description: Use the antiSMASH database, currently experimental. Raw antiSMASH output only.

use_rgi.description: Use RGI AMR analysis tool, currently experimental. Raw RGI output only.

use_card.description: Use the CARD database for annotation.

use_tcdb.description: Use the TCDB database for annotation.

save_cgc.description: Whether dbcan step should additionally run and save CAZyme Gene Cluster step information. Not consumed by DRAM, but maybe helpful for users.

add_annotations.description: Path to old annotations to add to the current run.

bit_score_threshold.description: Minimum BitScore of search to retain hits')

rbh_bit_score_threshold.description: Minimum BitScore of reverse best hits to retain hits

mmseqs_gpu_exclude_dbs.description: Comma-separated protein MMseqs databases that remain on CPUs when gpu profile is selected. Use none to send every GPU-capable database to GPUs. PFAM is always CPU-only.

mmseqs_cuda_cache.description: Persistent writable CUDA JIT cache shared by MMseqs GPU tasks.

qc_options.title: QC Options
qc_options.description: Quality control options for DRAM workflow. The QC step collects rRNA and tRNA scans using Barrnap and tRNAscan-SE for the genome_states.tsv output as a baseline. Additional options can be found below.

bin_quality.description: Path to bin quality tsv. CheckM and CheckM2 compatible.

taxa.description: Path to bin taxonomy tsv. Compatible with GTDB.

distill_options.title: Summarize Options
distill_options.description: The purpose of DRAM summarize is to distill down annotations based on curated distillation summary form(s). It can be ran with either just --sumarize, or currated sheets with --distill_topic, --distill_ecosystem, or --distill_custom (or some combination). User's may also provide a custom distillate via --distill_custom <path/to/file> (TSV forms). Summarize can be ran independent of --annotate however, annotations must be provided (--annotations <path/to/annotations.tsv>). Optional tRNA, rRNA and bin quality may also be provided. When using distll, you also must use kegg, ko, dbcan, or merops when you do your annotation. To get the full results, you need to use kegg or ko and dbcan and merops.

sum_ecos.description: Ecosystem to distill. Options: <eng_sys|ag|marine|gut|bgc> If more than one ecosystem included, they must be seperated by a comma (--sum_ecos eng_sys,ag or --sum_ecos 'eng_sys,ag').

sum_topics.description: A way to specify a subset of topics instead of all topics. By default, if `--sumarize` is specified, all topics are included. Options:  <assim|cell|energy|env|none> OR <default = assim,cell,energy,env>. If more than one topic included, they must be seperated by a comma (--sum_topics assim,energy or --distill_topic 'assim,energy'). Use `none` to skip topic distillation.

sum_custom.description: <path/to/custom_distillate.tsv>  Custom distill file to use. The custom distill file must be in TSV format with the first column being the gene ID and the second column being the distillate value.

annotations.description: Path to an annotations TSV for summarize, QC enrichment, visualization, or traits without running annotate.

rrnas.description: Path to a directory containing individual rRNA TSV files generated with Barrnap. Can be used by QC without raw FASTA input.

trnas.description: Path to a directory containing individual tRNA TSV files generated with tRNAscan-SE. Can be used by QC without raw FASTA input.

distill_dummy_sheet.description: File path to distill dummy sheet.

product_options.title: Visualization Options
product_options.description: The purpose of DRAM --visualize is to generate a product visualization of the annotations and save the output to the output directory.

viz_rules_tsv.description: This is an optional path to a custom rules file with strict formatting. It will over write the default rules file. This option cannot be specified if `viz_rules_system` is specified.

viz_rules_system.description: Choose alternative in-built rules for the visualization. This option cannot be specified if `viz_rules_tsv` is specified. comma seperated list with the same options as `sum_ecos`. (ex. `--viz_rules_system ag,bgc`)

viz_mapping_file.description: Path to metaT mapping file of gene abundances in samples. Must have a column named 'Geneid' that matches the query_id column in the annotations file.

viz_common_rules_tsv.description: Path to common rules file of aliases used throughout the visualizations

adjectives_options.title: Trait Options
adjectives_options.description: The purpose of DRAM --traits is to use the outputted DRAM annotations file to make a table of adjectives. You need to use the Kegg, FeGenie, and Sulfur Databases.

trait_rules_tsv.description: This is an optional path to a rules file with strict formatting. It will take the place of the original rules file that is stored with the script. For formatting, see the original rules.tsv sheet stored with the script in the repo.

trait_common_rules_tsv.description: Path to common rules file of aliases used throughout the visualizations

database_options.title: Database Options
database_options.description: File paths to databases used in the workflow.

format_kegg_options.title: Format Kegg Options
format_kegg_options.description: Options for preparing the KEGG database for use in DRAM.

kegg_pep_root_dir.description: Only required if you need to concatenate all of KEGG's provided pep files. Root directory to downloaded KEGG peptide files. The pipeline will search for all pep files in this directory and concatenate them into a single file. In format <root_dir>/*/*.pep.

kegg_pep_loc.description: Path to and of the gene fasta files that are provided by the KEGG FTP server or a concatenated version of them. Either this or kegg_pep_root_dir must be provided.

gene_ko_link_loc.description: Path to and of the KO file that is provided by the KEGG FTP server.

skip_gene_ko_link.description: Skip the gene_ko_link file. If you are using an older version of KEGG that does not supply the gene_ko_link file you can use this option to skip the gene_ko_link file. Otherwise, the gene_ko_link file is required.

kegg_download_date.description: The date the KEGG database was downloaded. If not provided, the current date will be used.

format_mmseqs_gpu_options.title: Format MMseqs GPU Database Options
format_mmseqs_gpu_options.description: Options for converting an existing protein MMseqs database into a GPU-padded database with a subset-2 index.

mmseqs_db_path.description: Directory containing the existing MMseqs database.

mmseqs_db_name.description: Database prefix without the .mmsdb suffix, such as kegg or uniref.

process_options.title: Process resource options
process_options.description: Per-task resource caps, optional input batching, and job arrays. Resource caps do not increase the resources requested by a process.

gpu_container_options.description: Override container GPU flags for GPU tasks. Auto-detects if not set (--gpus all for Docker, --nv for Singularity/Apptainer).

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs that any single task can request.

max_memory.description: Maximum memory that any single task can request, for example '64.GB'.

max_time.description: Maximum wall time that any single task can request, for example '48.h'.

call_batch_size.description: Maximum FASTA inputs processed sequentially per CALL_GENES task. 1 disables batching.

call_batch_max_size.description: Largest individual FASTA that may join a CALL_GENES batch. Larger inputs run alone; combined batch size is ignored.

rna_batch_size.description: Maximum FASTA inputs processed sequentially per tRNA or rRNA scan task. 1 disables batching.

rna_batch_max_size.description: Largest individual FASTA that may join an RNA-scan batch. Larger inputs run alone; combined batch size is ignored.

search_batch_size.description: Maximum inputs searched sequentially against one database per HMM/MMseqs task. 1 disables batching. Can be combined with job arrays.

search_batch_max_size.description: Largest individual query input that may join a search batch, for example '1.GB'. Inputs above this size run alone. Database size and combined batch size are ignored. Use a positive integer and unit.

job_array_size.description: Maximum tasks per job array on supported executors. Values 0 and 1 disable arrays; values 2 or greater enable them for array-labelled processes.

aliased_options.title: aliased_options
aliased_options.description: Aliased options for DRAM annotation workflow. These are provided for backward compatibility with older versions of the pipeline.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service
hook_url.help_text: Incoming hook URL for messaging service. Currently, MS Teams and Slack are supported.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.
